title: PISA 2025 Students' reading and mathematics performance declined across the OECD
summary: The OECD released PISA 2025 results showing a sharp decline in student performance across reading and mathematics in OECD countries, indicating ongoing educational challenges globally.
problem_solved: It documents and reports on the declining academic performance of students in reading and mathematics across developed nations.
why_valuable: It provides critical data for policymakers and educators to understand current educational trends and allocate resources to address student learning gaps.
